summary: refactor(readiness): address shotgun surgery on issues variable

delivery.outcome: Shotgun surgery on 'issues' removed: mutable accumulator lists replaced by _present_issues composition and single-issue predicate functions (_socket_health_issue, _daemon_pid_issue, _socket_inode_drift_issue, _daemon_project_mismatch_issue, _daemon_python_mismatch_issue, _queue_runner_lock_issue).
nonGoals: Changing issue codes, severities, messages or fix commands

architecture.decision: Each conditional issues.append becomes a function returning ReadinessIssue|None; aggregators compose via _present_issues. Facade re-export names (_append_issue, _check_socket_health_issues) preserved for monkeypatch compatibility.
architecture.rollback: Revert the ticket branch; pure function-level refactor in one module.

validation.evidence: Readiness issues, severities, fix commands and result payloads unchanged.
